<function name="PostAutoRefresh" parent="PANEL" type="hook">
	<description>
Only works on elements defined with <page>derma.DefineControl</page> and only if the panel has **AllowAutoRefresh** set to true.

Called after <page>derma.DefineControl</page> is called with panel's class name.

See also <page>PANEL:PreAutoRefresh</page>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
